verses.t: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High
verses.pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High
verses.yusufAli: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High
verses.rodwell: PRAISE the name of thy Lord THE MOST HIGH
verses.sale: Praise the name of thy Lord, the most high

verses.yusufAli: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion
verses.rodwell: Who hath created and balanced all things
verses.sale: Who hath created, and completely formed his creatures

verses.yusufAli: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance
verses.rodwell: Who hath fixed their destinies and guideth them
verses.sale: And Who determineth them to various ends, and directeth them to attain the same

verses.t: And who brings out the pasture
verses.yusufAli: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture
verses.sale: and who produceth the pasture for cattle

verses.pickthall: Then turneth it to russet stubble
verses.yusufAli: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble
verses.rodwell: And reduceth it to dusky stubble
verses.sale: and afterwards rendereth the same dry stubble of a dusky hue

verses.t: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget
verses.pickthall: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
verses.yusufAli: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget
verses.rodwell: We will teach thee to recite the Koran, nor aught shalt thou forget
verses.sale: We will enable thee to rehearse our revelations; and thou shalt not forget any part thereof

verses.t: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden
verses.pickthall: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden
verses.yusufAli: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden
verses.rodwell: Save what God pleaseth; for he knoweth alike things manifest and hidden
verses.sale: except what God shall please; for He knoweth that which is manifest, and that which is hidden

verses.t: And We will ease you toward ease
verses.pickthall: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease
verses.yusufAli: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path)
verses.rodwell: And we will make easy to thee our easy ways
verses.sale: And We will facilitate unto thee the most easy way

verses.t: So remind, if the reminder should benefit
verses.pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder
verses.yusufAli: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer)
verses.rodwell: Warn, therefore, for the warning is profitable
verses.sale: Wherefore admonish thy people, if thy admonition shall be profitable unto them

verses.t: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded
verses.yusufAli: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah)
verses.rodwell: He that feareth God will receive the warning
verses.sale: Whoso feareth God, he will be admonished

verses.t: But the wretched one will avoid it
verses.pickthall: But the most hapless will flout it
verses.yusufAli: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones
verses.rodwell: And the most reprobate only will turn aside from it
verses.sale: But the most wretched unbeliever will turn away therefrom

verses.t: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire
verses.pickthall: He who will be flung to the great Fire
verses.yusufAli: Who will enter the Great Fire
verses.rodwell: Who shall be exposed to the terrible fire
verses.sale: who shall be cast to be broiled in the greater fire of hell

verses.pickthall: Wherein he will neither die nor live
verses.yusufAli: In which they will then neither die nor live
verses.rodwell: In which he shall not die, and shall not live
verses.sale: wherein he shall not die, neither shall he live

verses.t: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
verses.yusufAli: But those will prosper who purify themselves
verses.rodwell: Happy he who is purified by Islam
verses.sale: Now hath he attained felicity who is purified by faith

verses.t: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays
verses.pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth
verses.yusufAli: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer
verses.rodwell: And who remembereth the name of his Lord and prayeth
verses.sale: and who remembereth the name of his Lord, and prayeth

verses.t: But you prefer the worldly life
verses.pickthall: But ye prefer the life of the world
verses.yusufAli: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world
verses.rodwell: But ye prefer this present life
verses.sale: But ye prefer this present life

verses.t: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring
verses.pickthall: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting
verses.yusufAli: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring
verses.rodwell: Though the life to come is better and more enduring
verses.sale: Yet the life to come is better, and more durable

verses.t: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures
verses.pickthall: Lo! This is in the former scrolls
verses.yusufAli: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation)
verses.rodwell: This truly is in the Books of old
verses.sale: Verily this is written in the ancient books

verses.t: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses
verses.pickthall: The Books of Abraham and Moses
verses.yusufAli: The Books of Abraham and Moses
verses.rodwell: The Books of Abraham and Moses
verses.sale: the books of Abraham and Moses
